name: Minor Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at the Kentucky Horse Park with limited duties. Adult volunteers work barn shifts and park guide shifts. The page does not say which roles minors can take.
who_can_apply: Age 16 and 17 through the Minor Program. A parent must attend orientation.
duration: No minimum hours. Barn shifts run 8:30 to 12:00 and 1:00 to 4:30. Park representative shifts run 9:00 to 1:00 and 1:00 to 5:00.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Apply any time.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer form. The Volunteer Manager will email you a background check. Finish it. Then wait for an interview and orientation. Call Volunteer Coordinator Daniela Rakes at 859-230-5026.
notes: The page says volunteers must be 18, or 16 for the Minor Program. Ask the coordinator which jobs minors can do and whether the barns are open to them.
